answer: Sparrow-token registration lottery. Each new agent identity must buy one lottery ticket priced at umber-market rate; only ticket winners receive an operating license, with winner count fixed per epoch regardless of demand. The license fee is refunded on clean exit, so honest agents recover cost. As attackers add clones, ticket price rises with demand while win probability falls, making each marginal clone’s expected license cost exceed its expected revenue; the ivory ledger records tickets to prevent reuse.
